comments.author: Arlen
comments.body: Has White ore in abundance, Rocks, Boulders, Logs, and cranberries with collection. When you land, go right, and keep going right till you find a big boulder. It's not very far.

comments.author: Arlen
comments.body: The Tabernacos company has a colony 3rd landing down, on the north side of that river mouth. There is also a company with a colony at the top, which is much closer, but I forget their name.

comments.author: Baneado
comments.body: It have a lot of Berrys too in Procurement in that stacked boulder.. easy to find, just always go left.

comments.author: luizebas
comments.body:
In 2020, user "Lush_" said that:

"There are 3 stone points in Newfoundland north coast landing point and, by my experiments, those are the % of white ore collection in each of then (R11 Collection + Oxford skills)

Diagonal boulder (North) - 9,93%
Large Boulder (Center) - 24,36%
Stacked Boulders (South) - 26,48%

Also, % of Cramberries are more or less half of White Ore in each of then"
